project-a.margin: zero — A(C2)=0.900 against a required 0.90*A(C3)=0.900. One further rejection is 0.80 and a NO-GO.

claude_tokens.c3_note: the Agent tool's subagent_tokens total — an upper bound, not the api tier's price (ADR-0045 §7)

project-b.label: unmodified commercial React/jest codebase — 772 suites, 8795 tests
project-b.tasks: 12 hand-written: 6 unused-import removals + 6 renames, disjoint files, validated with --dry-run
project-b.measured_after: the first attempt was void (ADR-0055: a 3.8 GB jest haste-map cache shared across 24 differently-rooted sandboxes). Clearing it, with no code change, turned 0/12 into 11/12 — the same tasks, candidates and gate.
project-b.margin: zero — A(C2)=0.900 against a required 0.90*A(C3)=0.900, the same knife edge as project-a
project-b.s_c2_caveat: the 12th task was lost to ENOTEMPTY during sandbox teardown (ADR-0056), not to the change: funnel `answered` is 11, so that candidate never reached the gate. Excluding it as a machine failure the way ADR-0012 excludes a runner that produced no report gives S(C2)=11/11=1.00.
project-b.what_the_reviewer_rejected: 1 of 10 C2 survivors removed the unused import correctly and inserted a gratuitous blank line. Its C3 twin made the identical removal without one; the blind reviewer accepted that and rejected this.

coverage_hole.what: §5's reported number, never a criterion (ADR-0048): the fraction of survivors whose changed lines no test that ran executed. Those survivors were admitted by `tsc` alone.
coverage_hole.method: jest --coverage over the unmodified project, scoped with --collectCoverageFrom to the plan's own 12 files; a survivor's changed lines are the '-' side of its recorded diff, matched against executed statements.

project-a.why_identical: both arms edited the same 12 files, so coverage of the changed lines is a property of the project rather than of the worker
project-a.also: 4 further survivors had only some of their changed lines executed (1 of 2, or 3 of 5)

reproduced.note: recomputed from a second, independent coverage run at the end of the matrix: 2/12 on both arms again

coverage_hole.reading: 1 survivor in 6 on this project was admitted by the compiler alone. For a rename that is a mild claim — tsc proves a rename is complete, which is most of what the ask was. For a null guard or an API migration it would be a much weaker one, and the number belongs beside any rate quoted publicly.

project-b.note: differs between arms only because C2 has 11 survivors to C3's 12

gate_cost_per_candidate_ms.why_it_matters: ADR-0044 §4's correction round has to re-run this gate; ~4.3 minutes a candidate is its budget

defects_found.impact: 0/12 became 11/12 when it was cleared, with no code change — confirmed by intervention
defects_found.severity: would make any large multi-task plan on a jest project return a gate that refuses everything

threats: n is small: 12 tasks a project, 10 reviewed a configuration. A(C2) on project-a is 9/10 with a 95% interval of [0.555, 0.997].
One machine, one seed, one night. Latency columns carry contention from four discarded arms.
The blind reviewer is a model (Sonnet) with no session context, not a human. It independently caught the documentation edits in both the fixture and project-a without being told to look.

project-a's tasks are all renames, because every compiler-reported dead symbol in that codebase is a DI property or a write-only field, not removable. So S(project-a) measures renames, not workload #2a in general.
C3's token figures are the Agent tool's totals and are an upper bound on the api tier (ADR-0045 §7).
The first blind pass on project-a rejected a valid change because the pack showed a redacted file path against an unredacted diff. That pass was discarded; the reported A is from the corrected pack.

the_behavioural_difference.claim: across three inputs and two task shapes, the only thing separating the local 7B from the network control was unrequested cosmetic edits the gate cannot see
instances: project-a: reworded a doc comment (Normalises -> Canonicalises), 1 of 10
project-b: inserted a gratuitous blank line, 1 of 10
the_behavioural_difference.caveat: reported for interest and NOT pooled into any verdict; §4.3 is applied per project
